title: Cover Git run-directory terminators and existing-path validation branches
outcome: Extend real launcher boundary controls for single CRLF success, legitimate path-space preservation, nonexistent absolute directory, a file instead of directory, and doubled terminal newline, retaining no-mkdir/no-registration assertions.
acceptance: Real createRun/executeRun controls accept a single CRLF terminator and platform-legal leading/trailing path spaces with correct run placement.
Missing absolute directory, regular-file path and doubled terminal newline are refused before artifacts or registration.
Maintained helper parity and the full gate pass on the final input, and an independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
